## Detailed country context

Country-specific information that adds context to the summary indicators above.

<div class="country-note-groups">
<details class="country-note-group">
<summary>
<span>Programme and transmission context</span>
<small>4 notes</small>
</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Subnational programme context</h4>
<p>District level; 3 categories; API; receptivity, vulnerability, eco-epidemiology; Stratum 3: API ≥1/1,000 high burden/high transmission; Stratum 2: API &lt;1/1,000 low burden/low transmission; Stratum 1: API=0 with receptive/vulnerable or traditionally non-endemic areas</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Cross-border context</h4>
<p>Two border districts - borders with Myanmar and India. Significant challenge</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Mobile and migrant population context</h4>
<p>Forest product traders in hilly border areas</p>
</div>
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>High-risk populations</h4>
<p>Mobile migrant populations, farmers, traders (forest product in hilly border areas), miners, fishermen, forest-goers, refugees (almost 1 million for Myanmar)</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
<details class="country-note-group">
<summary>

<small>1 note</small>
</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Diagnostic approach</h4>
<p>RDT, microscopy</p>
</div>
</div>

<details class="country-note-group">
<summary>
<span>Country-specific policy context</span>
<small>1 note</small>
</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Policy note</h4>
<p>2017 is most recent guidelines, and they are being updated this year (2026). G6PD testing (quantitative) will be included as a recommendation in the new guidelines. There are plans to roll out the STANDARD G6PD test at the district health centre level, after a pilot in the community showed that community testing was not possible. According to the NSP, phased implementation is planned.</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
</div>

<div class="country-note-groups country-note-groups--case-management">
<details class="country-note-group">
<summary>
<span>Additional policy notes</span>
<small>1 note</small>
</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Policy note</h4>
<p>G6PD Testing GF supported, update of guidelines 2023 but have not been able to find them online - according to Dr Mosiqure, 2017 is most recent guidelines, and they are being updated this year (2026). G6PD testing (quantitative) will be included as a recommendation in the new guidelines. There are plans to roll out the STANDARD G6PD test at the district health centre level, after a pilot in the community showed that community testing was not possible. According to the NSP, phased implementation is planned.</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
</div>
